mapper.select: SELECT t.*,GREATEST(t.created_at,t.updated_at,t.available_at) AS queued_at FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN novels n ON n.id=t.novel_id WHERE t.status IN ('WAITING','READY') AND t.available_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (t.novel_id IS NULL OR n.status IN ('PLANNING','WRITING','CHECKING','REFLECTING','EXTRACTING','CHECKING_MEMORY') OR (t.kind IN ('PLAN_CHANGE','COORDINATE') AND n.status IN ('PAUSED','AWAITING_PLAN','AWAITING_CHANGE','AWAITING_HELP','AWAITING_STAGE_REVIEW'))) ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks r WHERE r.status='RUNNING' AND (r.novel_id=t.novel_id OR (r.novel_id IS NULL AND t.novel_id IS NULL))),t.updated_at,t.created_at LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tasks SET status='RUNNING',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('WAITING','READY')
